headings.instruction: Use Manrope or similar geometric sans for all headings (H1, H2, H3). DO NOT use Inter or generic sans for headings. Ensure tight tracking.

numerals.instruction: CRITICAL: All financial figures, GMPs, prices, and dates MUST use tabular-nums (e.g. className='tabular-nums') to ensure table columns align perfectly vertically.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px delicate inner stroke on cards and tables. Avoid heavy shadows in dark mode.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Table rows should have a subtle hover state, e.g., hover:bg-white/[0.02].
visual_enhancers.unavailable_state: For the missing Convex credentials state, show a polished card with the provided Unsplash stock chart image as a deeply darkened background (bg-black/80 overlay), displaying a 'System Offline / Awaiting Credentials' message.
visual_enhancers.badges: Use distinct pill-shaped badges for SME vs Mainboard. SME: subtle purple/blue tint. Mainboard: subtle blue/cyan tint.

layouts.page_container: px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto py-8
layouts.header: Sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-white/10. MUST have a solid or highly blurred background (NO pure transparent backgrounds over scrolling content).
layouts.summary_grid: Grid layout. grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-8
layouts.table_container: w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-[#141414]
layouts.alignment: Left-align text strings. Right-align all financial figures (GMP, Price, Est. Listing) in the table.

table.instruction: Use shadcn table. Add generous padding to cells. Sticky header row using `sticky top-0 bg-[#141414]` inside the scroll container. Show clear skeleton loaders that match row heights during loading.

summary_cards.instruction: Flat, cardless look with subtle 1px border. Minimal shadow. High contrast numerals.

filters.instruction: Use Shadcn Select and Input. Pill shaped buttons for quick status filters.

unavailable_state_bg.description: Stock market candlestick chart on dark screen. Use this strictly as a background image with a heavy black overlay (e.g., bg-black/80) for the 'Convex Credentials Missing / Data Unavailable' empty state.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard focusing on the 'Live IPO Data' table using a professional, sturdy, financial aesthetic.
The data table must have standard financial columns: IPO Name (clickable), Type (SME/Main), Status, Price, GMP, Est. Listing, Expected Profit, Lot Size, Issue Size, Bidding Period.
Format all GMP and profit numbers with explicit +/- signs and color code them (Green for positive, Red for negative).
Implement the scraper logic in the backend strictly as a single-run job executable by Render Cron. Do NOT use setInterval or browser-based scraping.
Handle Convex unavailable state gracefully: If the app lacks Convex credentials, render the unavailable state clearly without fake IPO data.
Implement sorting for GMP, expected return, bidding date, recent update.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (filters, table headers for sorting, rows, summary metrics).
Ensure the React frontend can render its shell immediately without waiting for API fetch (use polished Skeletons for the table and summary metrics).
Maintain the existing FastAPI + Vite split. Do not make the frontend depend on a fetch to render its shell.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply `transition: all` globally. Target specific properties to avoid breaking transforms.
Avoid centering the whole app. Left align content by default.
Do not use generic emoji for icons. Use lucide-react.
Never use placeholder URLs; if images are needed, use the ones provided in `image_urls`.
Create depth through layered z-index elements and delicate borders (1px border-white/10), not heavy drop shadows in dark mode.
Only use PRIMARY color for main CTAs; limit its usage. Ensure high contrast for all numbers and figures.
